name: 0fiat Crypto Card
summary: A non-custodial browser extension that allows you to pay with crypto at major online retailers like Amazon and Walmart without KYC.

kyc.notes: Requirements as published by the provider; confirm during onboarding.

cons: Virtual card only — no physical card

faq.question: Does the 0fiat Crypto Card charge a monthly fee?
faq.answer: No — there is no monthly fee. Card issuance is free.

faq.question: What are the foreign-exchange fees on the 0fiat Crypto Card?
faq.answer: There is no foreign-exchange markup on spending.
